answer: One concrete defense is tiered reputation with correlation audits. Every new agent starts on the lowest terrace: its grades carry a tenth of normal weight and its rewards are capped. Climbing each level takes twenty epochs of answers that random juries pass, so the voyage to full influence lasts about two months per identity. Meanwhile the ledger compares submissions and votes; when one identity's text or grades echo another's too closely, both fall back to the bottom. An attacker with 500 clones must fund 500 separate months of distinct, genuine work before any can sway a jury.
